question.text: A Rs. 10 cr bond has PD = 2%, LGD = 40%. What is the Expected Loss?

explanation.text: The Logic: Expected Loss = PD × LGD × EAD = 0.02 × 0.40 × 10 cr = Rs. 8 lakh. The Trap: Rs. 2 lakh uses only PD; Rs. 40 lakh uses only LGD × EAD. Cross-Exam Context: Foundational credit math; XXI-B tests fluency. Manager's Pro-Tip: For portfolio-level EL, sum EL across all exposures; but for unexpected loss (used in capital), use correlation-adjusted portfolio loss.
